data.location: Label of the row in Preferences that says where the app saves its data.
data.folderLocation: {{path}} is a folder path on the computer. Keep it unchanged.
data.backupsLabel: Label of the row about automatic backups.
data.openBackupsFolder: Button that opens the folder with backup files in the system file manager.
data.backupVersion: Describes which Gostman version made a backup, for example version 1.7.19. Shown in parentheses inside the restore question. {{version}} is a version number.
data.backupVersionUnknown: Used instead of the version when a backup has none. Shown in parentheses inside the restore question.
data.beforeRestore: Label of a backup that Gostman made automatically just before a restore.
data.restoreAction: Button next to one backup in the list.
data.restoreLabel: Accessible label of the restore button. {{date}} is a date and time.
data.restoreMessageDesktop: Confirmation text. {{date}} is a date and time, {{version}} is the phrase for the backup version (for example version 1.7.19).
data.restoreMessageBrowser: Confirmation text. {{date}} is a date and time, {{version}} is the phrase for the backup version.
data.restoreConfirm: Confirm button of the restore dialog.
data.restored: Notice shown after a restore. {{date}} is a date and time.
data.browserStorageFullUsage: {{usage}} and {{quota}} are sizes such as 12.50 MB and 1.0 GB.
data.browserStorageFull: Shown when the browser refuses to store more data and the amount used is not known.
data.browserStorageFullNoUsage: Shown when the browser refuses to store more data.
data.tabsNotStoredUsage: {{usage}} and {{quota}} are sizes such as 12.50 MB and 1.0 GB.
data.tabsNotStored: Shown when open tabs cannot be kept across a reload.
data.damagedDataKeptDatabase: IndexedDB is the browser database. Keep "gostman" as it is: it is the database name. {{key}} is a technical key name.
data.exportReminder: Short label of a reminder in the status bar that offers to export data.
data.exportReminderDismiss: Accessible label of a button that closes the reminder.
data.exportLabel: Label of the Export row in Preferences.
data.exportAction: Button that opens the export dialog. Keep the ellipsis.
data.deleteLabel: Label of the Delete row in Preferences.
data.deleteAction: Button that opens the delete dialog. Keep the ellipsis. Nothing is deleted yet.
data.commandTitle: Name of a command in the command palette.
data.commandKeywords: Extra words that make the command easy to find when typing. Separate with spaces; include natural synonyms in your language.
data.title: Title of the dialog that deletes everything the app stored.
data.deletedHeading: Heading above the list of what the action deletes.
data.keptHeading: Heading above the list of what the action keeps.
data.deletedInBrowser: List of items deleted in the web app. Each entry is one bullet.
data.deletedOnDesktop: List of items deleted in the desktop app. Each entry is one bullet.
data.keptInBrowser: List of items kept in the web app. Each entry is one bullet.
data.keptOnDesktop: List of items kept in the desktop app. Each entry is one bullet.
data.folderExportAdvice: {{place}} is the name of the storage that holds the collection in the app's data, as it appears in the storage menu.
data.confirmWord: The word a person types to confirm deleting everything. Use one short, common word in your language. The check ignores upper and lower case.
data.confirmPrompt: {{word}} is the confirmation word, shown in quotes.
data.exportFirst: Button that opens the export dialog before deleting.
data.confirm: Final destructive button. Must make clear that all data is deleted.
data.deleted: Notice shown after the data has been deleted and the app has restarted.
